title: Choose Fieldio's homepage structure
question: Each option keeps the same minimal Fieldio identity. Choose the composition that should lead the launch storefront.

options.label: The Catalog Index
options.thesis: The launch opens as a disciplined luxury edit where products and brands are immediately shoppable.
options.viewport: A centered wordmark and narrow utility header sit above filters and a dense four-column edit; a quiet brand story breaks the grid below.
options.risk: It is the clearest shopping route, but the first screen feels less cinematic than the other directions.

options.label: The Product Salon
options.thesis: One sourced piece owns the first screen, turning discovery into an intimate personal-shopping appointment.
options.viewport: An oversized product gallery fills two thirds of the frame while name, brand, size, enquiry, and WhatsApp purchase controls form a narrow right column.
options.risk: It creates the strongest luxury focus, but fewer products are visible before scrolling.

options.label: The Editorial Lookbook
options.lineage: Fieldio reference: split campaign and long-form gallery
options.thesis: Fieldio reads like a seasonal fashion issue whose images unfold into product edits, categories, and sourcing services.
options.viewport: A slim filter rail gives way to two tall campaign panels with names and collection copy set directly over photography; products enter immediately below.
options.risk: It is the most memorable direction and demands the strongest ongoing photography discipline.
